title: Material Office
headline: Cloth by the cut
intro: Three cloths for a first prototype. Pick the cuts you want on your sample rail.
alt: A loop of undyed linen against forest-green twill and a dark cork tile

items.name: Raw linen
items.note: Open weave with a dry hand. Hold a single layer against the light.

items.name: Forest twill
items.note: Close diagonal ribs. Try a deep fold to see how the face catches light.

items.name: Ink canvas
items.note: A firm, plain weave for structured panels. Compare it with the softer linen.
